trigger: Post-v5 diagnosis: ratio-scale failures and room-dependent A/C tradeoffs; geometry/grid sources still missing locally
scope: Optional bounded P10 fusion experiment only, no new simulations or regression-estimator fitting; independent source geometry work remains the priority
models: Frozen v5 A_RandomForest relative P10 and C_RandomForest direct asinh P10, base B13 features only
prediction: w * A_P10 + (1-w) * C_P10; same scalar weight for every outer-held room hour and angle
outer: Same seven LeaveOneRoomOut folds; protected TEST excluded
inner: For each outer fold use only its saved v5 inner OOF predictions on the six fitting rooms, with the already inner-selected per-formulation candidate; choose weight by mean room original-unit MAE. Exact ties prefer larger weight on A.
no_leakage: No outer room labels for weight selection; never choose method or weight by held-room name. Pointwise true-label oracle is diagnostic only.
development_gate: Against A: macro MAE reduction >=10%; >=5/7 rooms nonworse; worst-room MAE does not increase
stopping_rule: If fusion fails the gate, retain A and stop expanding weights/routing models without new independently available input information; no post-hoc room-specific routing
scope_limit: Development pilot; previously reused seven rooms, not independent final evidence. No promise of improvement. Requires confirmation before execution.
